reproduction.summary: A customer presentation does not provide a reliable player-visible bottom-door entry and explicit product shelf pickup transition before checkout.
reproduction.evidence: Validated FIX delegation: current customer view starts above checkout instead of at the declared door; route/pickup transition lacks explicit visible evidence.
reproduction.defaultJourney: startup -> customer enters from bottom door -> walks to product shelf -> consumes shelf stock -> checkout queue -> settlement -> replay

classification.scope: customer route presentation and lifecycle synchronization only

acceptanceCriteria: Every newly presented customer is visibly anchored at CUSTOMER_ENTRY before movement begins.
The route visibly targets the requested product shelf and retains the product cue.
The visual branch stays at the shelf while the simulation is waitingStock and only targets checkout after shelf stock is consumed.
A completed customer remains replayable: later customers can enter through the same door and complete the same route.
No unrelated economy, save, platform, or factory files are modified.

remainingEvidenceGaps: Platform-specific WeChat, Douyin and TapTap packaging was not exercised by this web-lite FIX QA run.
